x: Afterwards they all agreed that they had had an enjoyable race! A newcomer to most of us, but one who has already made a name for himself in the North, W. Hewitt, ran home a very comfortable winner.
Close (S.A.C.) was again the winner, with W. Hewitt, of ours, running in excellent style, second.
William Hewitt (ex-Gateshead Congers A.C., and Abbotts Langley), who was serving with the R.A.M.C. somewhere in the Portsmouth district.

William Hewitt, who we last heard of in the Portsmouth district, whilst serving in the R.A.M.C., has turned up in Scotland (Dumfries). He says athletics in his unit are dead, but has got together a " school " who are doing a bit of training, including a native of Putney, who without any trainig did 15.6 for 3 miles.
Bill Hewitt, in the R.A.M.C. and now with the B.N.A.F., writes that he is now married. (All the very best, Bill.) He says that he has a jog along the sea shore before sun-up just to keep in trim.

Bill Hewitt finished second in the 1,500 metres in a district athletic championship at Florence.
Bill Hewitt, serving with the R.A.M.C. in Italy, recently won a 5,000 metres race for the Army at Udine. The R.A.F. and New Zealand Forces were also taking part.
